GIFT_SUBTITLE: Hides the gift button in the chat input.
VOICE_MESSAGE_SUBTITLE: Hides the microphone that records a voice message.
VOICE_CALL_SUBTITLE: Hides the call buttons in DM headers and on profiles.
VIDEO_CALL_SUBTITLE: Hides the video call buttons in DM headers.
QUESTS_SUBTITLE: Hides Quests from the bar on the You screen.
SHOP_SUBTITLE: Hides the Shop from the bar on the You screen.
SERVER_BOOSTS_SUBTITLE: Hides Server Boosts at the top of a server's channel list.
